changelog:
opencli-adapter-author 1.0.1

- Added required "strategy note" step before coding: must document and justify data-fetching approach.
- New `Strategy` ladder and decision table: now formally differentiates PUBLIC_API, COOKIE_API, DOM/UI, internal, and interception strategies, emphasizing stability and maintenance cost.
- Detailed guidance for filling out strategy justification and evidence, including explicit contract/evidence checklists.
- Updated browser debug workflow: advise `--trace on`, `--keep-tab true`, `--window foreground`.
- Expanded runbook and reference, including with new jsdom-fixture-pattern, strategy-selection, and typed-errors docs.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md; updated conventions throughout for clarity and accuracy.
summary: Use when writing an OpenCLI adapter for a new site or adding a new command to an existing site. Guides end-to-end from first recon through field decoding, adapter coding, and verify. Replaces opencli-oneshot / opencli-explorer. For ad-hoc browser driving (no adapter), see opencli-browser instead; for a top-level orientation to opencli, see opencli-usage.
